This recommendation is from issue to issue, please:
* point/describe, with what ASVS requirement it's related
* define what is exactly the problem you want to point out or solve
* what is your proposal

Without those simple and clear elements in issue, all those links to n different sources are just noise. Or I just failing to understand those posts and comments...
